summary.intent: Execute Phase 35 of the cipher-box project, migrating the TEE worker to Phala Cloud CVM (testnet), including structural refactoring, unit tests, Phala SDK integration, staging infra updates, documentation, and live CVM deployment with end-to-end verification.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans completed across 4 waves. TEE worker relocated to apps/tee-worker/ with shared monorepo packages, 58 unit tests passing, live Phala Cloud CVM deployed and verified (epoch persistence, IPNS republish, latency baselines). Security review conducted and all 6 high/medium findings fixed. PR FSM1/cipher-box#395 created.

repo: Phala Cloud has no separate testnet — the free tier runs on the same production nodes (Intel TDX hardware, prod5 cluster) as paid deployments. The phase name 'phala-testnet-tee-migration' is a misnomer.
Docker is not available locally — it runs on the Docker host at 192.168.133.12
The monorepo uses pnpm workspaces. TEE worker now uses @cipherbox/crypto (ECIES), @cipherbox/core (IPNS signing), @cipherbox/sdk-core (KuboProvider/PsaProvider)
GitHub staging environment uses PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY (secret) and PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL (variable). TEE worker secret is STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET.
The deploy-staging.yml workflow has build-tee and deploy-tee-phala jobs for Phala Cloud deployment automation.
gsd-tools init requires running from within the correct working directory — running from the main repo when a worktree is active causes phase_found: false.

code.finding: Was incorrectly calling getKeypair() instead of getPublicKey(), leaking private key into route scope. Fixed during /simplify review.
Was reading TEE_EPOCH env var but migrate route uses TEE_CURRENT_EPOCH — inconsistency fixed during /simplify.

TOCTOU DNS race: DNS lookup happened separately from HTTP fetch, allowing DNS rebinding attacks against cloud metadata endpoints. Fixed by merging validateResolvedIp into ssrfSafeFetch — resolves DNS once, pins the IP, connects directly with explicit Host header.
Headers API (new Headers().entries()) lowercases all header names when iterating. Setting 'Host' directly bypasses this. Tests must match the actual case used in the implementation.
Epoch cache had no size bound — added MAX_CACHE_SIZE=100. Public key route had no epoch bounds validation — added 1-10000 range check.

Was reading TEE_CURRENT_EPOCH once at module load time (stale after rotation). Fixed to accept currentEpoch from request body with env var fallback. Added CIDv0/CIDv1 format validation for user-provided CIDs.
Had redundant mutable successes/failures counters that could be derived from results array. Dead keyEpoch field declared but never read. Added MAX_BATCH_SIZE=100 guard.
Using req.path as Prometheus label for unmatched routes causes unbounded label cardinality. Fixed to use literal 'unmatched' string for 404 fallback.

workflow: GSD pause-work / resume-work handoff flow works well for transferring sessions between machines — HANDOFF.json is the primary resumption artifact and should be deleted after successful resumption.
When parallel gsd-executor agents encounter git config lock contention, running plans sequentially resolves the issue.
classifyHandoffIfNeeded error in Claude Code agent completion is a runtime bug, not a GSD failure — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to confirm real success.
Merging agent worktrees often produces STATE.md conflicts; the agent's version is authoritative and should be taken with git checkout --theirs.
Security review should update the REVIEW .md document to mark findings as resolved after fixes are applied — it was initially skipped and needed a follow-up.

The /simplify code review caught a critical security bug (private key exposure in public-key route) that had passed all tests — running it before security:review would have reduced the security review scope.

friction: Usage limit hit mid-execution during Wave 2 parallel run — 35-03 agent was cut off. Required manual retry after reset.
Git config lock contention when two agent worktrees ran in parallel — Wave 2 had to be retried sequentially.
gsd-tools init returning phase_found: false when run from the main repo directory instead of the worktree — required manual path debugging.
Stale HANDOFF.json reference to an 'uncommitted Dockerfile fix' that had already been committed in a previous session — caused a brief interruption.
CVM health check after restart required 5+ retry attempts with increasing waits — no structured polling mechanism in phala CLI.
open_items: SSRF probe deduplication: connection-test.ts has its own probe logic that overlaps with sdk-core's connection testing — deferred as significant refactor.

Auth token string lifetime (HIGH-02): JS strings are immutable and persist until GC — nullification minimizes window but cannot guarantee zeroing. Fundamental JS limitation, acknowledged with comments.
Phase name 'phala-testnet-tee-migration' is a misnomer (it's production infra) — directory name kept as-is to avoid breaking cross-references, but docs updated.
Latency baselines (~1155ms avg) are network-bound from the test machine to Phala Cloud — production co-location latency not yet measured.
Human UAT file 35-HUMAN-UAT.md persists with status: partial — will surface in /gsd:progress until /gsd:verify-work is run on it.
Low-priority security findings (clearBytes vs .fill(0) consistency, hexToBytes vs Buffer.from) left as-is — trivial and not worth churn.
